newsitem.title: USA: NYS Gov sets briefing on an 'economic development'.
newsitem.headline: NYS Gov sets briefing on an 'economic development'.

text.p: New York Gov. George Pataki plans to brief reporters at 1230 EDT in New York City on a "major economic development," according to his daily schedule.

A financial source, who declined to be named, said Pataki would announce a "retention" agreement with the accounting firm, Price Waterhouse LLP, which is based in New York City. The source had no additional information.
A spokesman for Pataki was not immediately available.
Price Waterhouse spokesmen were not available to comment. A firm employee said she had been instructed to say: "We won't be putting out any information ahead of the conference."
